command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_01','AGG_SW_02','AGG_SW_03','AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','BJHQ_CSR1000V_GW_01','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR','SZ_Core'); `$cmds=@('show running-config','display current-configuration'); `$p='^(\s*(sysname|hostname|interface|description|ip address|ipv6 address|ip route|ip route-static|ip routing|router |ospf|isis|bgp|mpls|segment-routing|traffic|qos|bandwidth|speed|mtu|shutdown|undo shutdown|vlan|port access vlan|port trunk permit vlan|stp |peer |network |route-policy|ip-prefix|static-route|l2vpn|l3vpn|vpn-instance|ip vpn-instance))'; foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { foreach (`$c in `$cmds) { `$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e); if (`$r.output -notlike 'Error:*') { Write-Output ('===== NODE='+`$n+' COMMAND='+`$c+' ====='); (`$r.output -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { `$_ -match `$p } } } }"
